location.address_or_site: County Road A / Beaver Dam Commerce Park / TID No. 10; TID No. 10 is bounded by Hemlock Road to the south, CTH W to the west, and CTH A to the north.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. City and Meta sources identify the Beaver Dam project as Meta's data center, Meta describes the project as being built, and the City fact sheet says the initial data center is expected to come online in 2027. No government completion, certificate-of-occupancy, energization, partial-live, or full-buildout record was located.

actions.access_caveat: TID/project-plan action; not a building permit, completion record, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government land-use/economic-development record for the data-center district.

actions.access_caveat: TID/project-plan action; not a building permit, completion record, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government confirmation that the TID is treated as a data-center district.

actions.government_body: Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation / Wisconsin Department of Revenue
actions.result_status: Wisconsin's official list identifies Degas LLC, County Road A, Beaver Dam, certified 2025-02-18 and to be constructed. Certification provides tax-exemption eligibility and is not a local zoning or building permit.
actions.access_caveat: State list; it does not publish local permit, parcel, or operating status.
actions.evidence_note: Government identity/location record for the qualified data center entity.

actions.result_status: Meta announced Beaver Dam, Wisconsin as its next data center campus, over 700,000 square feet, optimized for AI workloads, representing a $1B investment once completed with about 1,000 construction jobs and more than 100 operational jobs.
actions.access_caveat: Owner/developer announcement; does not provide building permit, energization, or commissioning status.
actions.evidence_note: Company source confirming Meta ownership/development and project scale.

actions.result_status: City posted Meta Beaver Dam Data Center key facts/resources, linking City FAQ/fact sheets, Meta fast facts, Alliant data-center information, and Meta's Beaver Dam data-center site.
actions.access_caveat: Public-information page; not a permit, CO, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government confirmation tying the Beaver Dam project to Meta and the public project materials.

actions.result_status: City fact sheet says the first phase is expected to create more than $300M in taxable value, potential full buildout more than $600M, the initial data center is expected to come online in 2027, and construction peak workforce is expected to exceed 1,000 skilled-trade jobs.
actions.access_caveat: Fact sheet; projected timing/value only and not evidence of energization or completion.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government source for construction-stage and projected online timing.

actions.result_status: PSC took up Alliant Energy's service-agreement application for a Beaver Dam data center in docket 6680-TE-115 and modified the agreement with termination-charge, reporting, financial-safeguard, energy-efficiency, renewable-energy-procurement, and future large-load-tariff requirements. The release expressly says PSC does not regulate data-center permitting, construction, or operations.

actions.access_caveat: Utility decision; customer identity and contract details are limited by the cited release and no building/energization result follows.
